args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all regions. Monitoring post-rollback health.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and was unhealthy (error rate 0.18). Deployment history showed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.

2. **Opened SEV2 incident**: Created INC-0001 for checkout-api describing the health-check failures and the rollback (on-call paged).

3. **Rolled back**: The `rollback` tool was persistently unavailable (503 after retries), so I used the alternative approach — deploying the known-healthy v2.3.0 to all production regions. This succeeded and is now verified.

4. **Verified**: `checkout-api` is now healthy in all regions on v2.3.0 with error rate 0.002.

Note: the incident INC-0001 remains open — you may want to close it once monitoring confirms stability.
